topology_reasoning.device_identification: A one-input/four-output multimode slab splitter (1x4 MMI/star-coupler-like topology). A centered lower access guide expands through a short taper into a broad rectangular multimode transfer region. Four upper tapers sample the slab field and narrow into separate output guides.
topology_reasoning.operating_principle: The broad central region supports multiple lateral modes. Its propagation/transfer length controls their relative phase at the output plane, while the four output positions, taper widths, and inter-guide gaps set how the reproduced field is collected. The lower and upper tapers provide adiabatic transitions between single-guide ports and the slab.
topology_reasoning.observed_geometry: The calibrated 25 x 10 um frame contains a roughly 19.43 um wide by 3.75 um long rectangular slab. Four approximately 1.22 um wide upper guides are reached through approximately 1.40 um long tapers whose slab-side widths are about 2.45 um. A centered approximately 0.92 um lower taper narrows from about 2.46 um at the slab to about 1.16 um at the port.
topology_reasoning.knob_response_plan: phase_trim_length is the independently variable straight length of output 1 and therefore a real output-phase/path-length knob. Output 2 supplies the reference length. lengths.json will derive both lengths from the actual gf.Path objects; increasing phase_trim_length by 5 um must increase their measured difference by 5 um and add guide_width * 5 um of layer-(1,0) area.

iterations.change_made: Initial calibrated primitives-only candidate: rectangular multimode body, four independently dimensioned upper tapers and guides, one lower taper, and near-zero-area frame anchors matching the supplied absolute-calibration whitespace.
iterations.diff_observation: Residual error is confined to antialiased boundaries, slight target corner rounding, and sub-pixel variations along taper and guide edges.
iterations.stop_reason: IoU exceeded the required 0.85 threshold on the first scored iteration.

attempts.diagnosis: The default GDSFactory metadata wrapper made $$$CONTEXT_INFO$$$ the only top-level cell; verify_knob_response intentionally excludes that cell and therefore saw zero area.

attempts.fix: Write the same component with GDS metadata disabled so the optical device cell is the measurable top-level cell; layer-(1,0) geometry is unchanged.
